name: @gears-frontx/frontx-template-mfe-demo
description: The FrontX MFE mechanics demo: four screens of one package (Hello World, Profile, Current Theme, Widgets Host) and two widget packages mounted in the Widgets Host's own extension domain. Apply onto a project that already has template-shell and template-kit-candidates applied; it cannot be applied next to template-mfe 0.1.0-alpha.2, which claims the same packages. The screens appear in the shell's menu without further wiring.
